findings.detail: B01 appears to count amortized-cost leaves in the denominator even though source SOI rows and the schedule total carry fair value.

rationale: B01 reports only 189 of 378 leaves with fair_value, but the raw source shows separate Amortized Cost and Fair Value columns and the 2025 schedule total fair value is 1,417,789 thousand, matching the bundle's extracted fund_quarter_fv_m of 1,417.789 million. A sampled SOI investment row also carries a fair value cell beside amortized cost. The flag is therefore caused by the check's denominator/scope counting non-fair-value leaves rather than by missing fair values in source or extraction.
